judgments.rationale: Subparagraph (B) establishes an express governing condition on subparagraph (A), specifying that the disclosure duty applies to a consumer reporting agency described in section 1681a(p) only if the request is made through the centralized source established pursuant to section 211(c) of the Fair and Accurate Credit Transactions Act of 2003. Incorporating this incoming qualification and its context quote completes the reading for independent use.

Subparagraph (B) limits the centralized source requirement strictly to consumer reporting agencies described in section 1681a(p). The proposed summary incorrectly expands this condition to agencies described in subsection (w).

Leaving the reading unchanged fails to incorporate the governing limitation in subparagraph (B), which directly restricts the enforceability of subparagraph (A) for agencies under section 1681a(p) to requests made through the centralized source.
